answer: The cheapest real defence: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because zephyr only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, inlet is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any nebula approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
